text.en:
holders of the degree of Master of National Security Administration shall be given preference in
promotion to existing vacant positions, as well as assignments to higher responsibility, particularly those
involving policy formulation in their respective units, ministries, agencies, offices or entities.

Initially, NDCP graduates belonging to the government service shall be granted the rank of CESO III
with corresponding compensation and other privileges in the Career Executive Service.

All laws, decrees, charters, executive orders, administrative orders, proclamations, rules and
regulations or parts thereof that are in conflict with this executive order are hereby repealed or modified
accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 27th day of May, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and eighty-one.
